title: On Committing the same fault twice
subtitle: 品格修养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）
meta: 主题语境：品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）　|　核心词汇：commit　|　正文 338 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 commit 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1967 the driver ① committed the same fault twice at once, and every passenger in the station said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three days on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the driver ② commits the same fault twice in the rain without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ commit the same fault twice at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ committed the same fault twice before — a line in the timetable for February 1961 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Committing the same fault twice at once, the driver said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the ticket at the far platform, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ commit the whole family to the work in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Commit the whole family to the work at once and never mention it again.

By 1974 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the timetable, and a new passenger from the next station ⑧ commits the whole family to the work at once every day without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the platform, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ committed the same fault twice again when nobody else would.

⑩ To commit the same fault twice, my mother said in 1979, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the station remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the station forgets, somebody commits the same fault twice in the rain again and somebody must commit the same fault twice at once all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 犯下（一般过去式 committed the same fault twice：1967 年司机头一回这样做，二话不说地）
B. v. 犯下（一般现在 commits the same fault twice：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 犯下（不定式 to commit the same fault twice：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 犯下（过去完成时 had committed the same fault twice：1961 年二月的时刻表上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 犯下（动名词 committing the same fault twice 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 投入（commit the whole family to the work：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去投入把全家投入这件事）
G. v. 投入（commit the whole family to the work：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 犯下（后段两处：新来的乘客照例 commits the whole family to the work，而母亲又一次 committed the same fault twice）

items.q: to commit the same fault twice
committed the same fault twice before
commit the whole family to the work in the rain
commit the whole family to the work at once
commits the whole family to the work at once
committed the same fault twice again

answers.why: commit 意为“犯下”，1967 年司机二话不说地犯下再一次犯同样的错，那是车站里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 committed。
commit 意为“犯下”，自那以后司机淋着雨把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 commits。
commit 意为“犯下”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯犯下再一次犯同样的错”，此处为不定式 to commit the same fault twice。
commit 意为“犯下”，时刻表里 二月 那行字说明早在 1974 年之前就有人犯下过，故用过去完成时 had committed。
commit 意为“犯下”，司机说“犯下再一次犯同样的错这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 committing the same fault twice 作主语。
commit 意为“投入”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去投入把全家投入这件事”，should ever 之后用原形 commit the whole family to the work。
commit 意为“投入”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻投入把全家投入这件事（commit the whole family to the work at once），以后再也不要提起。
commit 意为“犯下”，新来的乘客每个日子都照例投入把全家投入这件事，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 commits。
commit 意为“犯下”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次二话不说地犯下再一次犯同样的错，用一般过去式 committed 叙述。
commit 意为“犯下”，结尾那句是母亲 1979 年的话：要犯下再一次犯同样的错，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和车站记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1967 年，司机二话不说地犯下再一次犯同样的错；车站里每一个乘客都说这是头一回。（committed the same fault twice）
多年以后，司机仍淋着雨做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（commits the same fault twice）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯犯下再一次犯同样的错这件事本身。（to commit the same fault twice）
早在 1961 年就有人犯下再一次犯同样的错，二月那天时刻表上的一行字就是证据。（had committed the same fault twice）
司机说过，二话不说地犯下再一次犯同样的错这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（committing the same fault twice 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻投入把全家投入这件事，以后再也不要提起。（commit the whole family to the work，祈使句）
answers: In 1967 the driver committed the same fault twice at once, and every passenger in the station said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three days on, the driver still commits the same fault twice in the rain without being asked.
My mother said later that to commit the same fault twice at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had committed the same fault twice long before 1974, and the line in the timetable for February proves it.
Committing the same fault twice at once, the driver said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
The rule the old hands handed down was plain: Commit the whole family to the work at once and never mention it again.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 commit 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1967 the driver committed the same fault twice at once, and nobody in the station forgot it.
Even now the driver commits the same fault twice in the rain whenever the station asks.
Committing the same fault twice at once, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever commit the whole family to the work in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new passenger from the next station commits the whole family to the work at once every day, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother committed the same fault twice again, and the station remembered that half.
